comparison.objective: Clear rocks from rover wheel tracks without pushing them over a road edge; no rubric details beyond the brief.
comparison.physical_skill: Bulk obstacle relocation and edge-aware pushing/grasping, unlike coaxial mandrel placement, controlled impact, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Wheel tracks clear and rocks retained on the road; candidate instead requires four notch fractures, four contained tangs, undisturbed inserts, and no damage.
comparison.reason: Tests terrain clearing and loss avoidance, not precision insert finishing.
